title: Implement ProductController with CRUD and variant management
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/v1/products lists products with category and variants
Product supports is_variant flag with nested product_variants
SKU and barcode fields present; variant SKU/barcode supported
Kasir has read-only access to products
completion_summary: ProductController CRUD done: category+variants eager-load, is_variant nested variants (tx create/update/replace), kasir read-only, delete deactivates. Routes added. curl-verified.
